idea-plugin.name: Erlang
idea-plugin.description:
Erlang support for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, RubyMine and other JetBrains IDE.

Feel free to file new feature requests as an issue on GitHub.

If you find this plugin useful, consider making a donation to support the project.

The plugin can send anonymous usage counts once a day, only if you allow it. See the privacy policy.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Export type now keeps the quotes of a quoted type name, so the module still compiles (#1557)
  • Renaming a function with thousands of clauses no longer freezes the IDE (#1586)
  • The editor now flags ?FEATURE_ENABLED() and other wrong-arity feature macro uses next to an own -define (#1585)
  • Using ?FEATURE_ENABLED(Feature) no longer shows an argument mismatch when the module defines the macro with other arities (#1584)
  • Completion after ?MODULE: in a type spec now lists the types of the current module (#1583)
  • Go to Declaration no longer opens a type of another arity when no type of the used arity exists (#1570)
  • Smart completion now offers variables bound to products and divisions written with spaces, such as 2 * 3 (#1579)
  • and 15 more changes: full list
